name: Policy Decision and Enforcement Points
description: PDP/PEP architecture: where policies are evaluated, where decisions are enforced, how policies are distributed and cached.
purpose: Policy is centralized, enforcement is local.
acceptanceCriteria: PDP and PEP are separate concerns with distinct interfaces.
Policy decisions are cacheable with configurable TTL.
Policies are distributed from a central policy store.
Enforcement happens at the PEP closest to the resource.
Policy changes propagate to all PEPs within a bounded latency.
